title: On Resigning the post after twenty years
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：resign　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 resign 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the tailor ① resigned the post after twenty years in silence, and every customer in the shop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the tailor ② resigns the post after twenty years twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ resign the post after twenty years at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ resigned the post after twenty years before — a line in the order for November 1962 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Resigning the post after twenty years in silence, the tailor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the needle at the far mirror, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ resign themselves to another winter twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Resign themselves to another winter at once and never mention it again.

By 1975 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the order, and a new customer from the next shop ⑧ resigns themselves to another winter in silence every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the mirror, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ resigned the post after twenty years again when nobody else would.

⑩ To resign the post after twenty years, my mother said in 1980, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the shop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the shop forgets, somebody resigns the post after twenty years twice over again and somebody must resign the post after twenty years in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 辞职（一般过去式 resigned the post after twenty years：1968 年裁缝头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 辞职（一般现在 resigns the post after twenty years：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 辞职（不定式 to resign the post after twenty years：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 辞职（过去完成时 had resigned the post after twenty years：1962 年十一月的订单簿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 辞职（动名词 resigning the post after twenty years 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 听任（resign themselves to another winter：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去听任听凭又一个冬天到来）
G. v. 听任（resign themselves to another winter：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 辞职（后段两处：新来的顾客照例 resigns themselves to another winter，而母亲又一次 resigned the post after twenty years）

answers.why: resign 意为“辞职”，1968 年裁缝一言不发地辞职二十年后辞去那个职位，那是裁缝铺里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 resigned。
resign 意为“辞职”，自那以后裁缝来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 resigns。
resign 意为“辞职”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯辞职二十年后辞去那个职位”，此处为不定式 to resign the post after twenty years。
resign 意为“辞职”，订单簿里 十一月 那行字说明早在 1975 年之前就有人辞职过，故用过去完成时 had resigned。
resign 意为“辞职”，裁缝说“辞职二十年后辞去那个职位这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 resigning the post after twenty years 作主语。
resign 意为“听任”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去听任听凭又一个冬天到来”，should ever 之后用原形 resign themselves to another winter。
resign 意为“听任”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻听任听凭又一个冬天到来（resign themselves to another winter at once），以后再也不要提起。
resign 意为“辞职”，新来的顾客每个星期都照例听任听凭又一个冬天到来，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 resigns。
resign 意为“辞职”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地辞职二十年后辞去那个职位，用一般过去式 resigned 叙述。
resign 意为“辞职”，结尾那句是母亲 1980 年的话：要辞职二十年后辞去那个职位，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和裁缝铺记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 resign 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1968 the tailor resigned the post after twenty years in silence, and nobody in the shop forgot it.
Even now the tailor resigns the post after twenty years twice over whenever the shop asks.
Resigning the post after twenty years in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever resign themselves to another winter twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new customer from the next shop resigns themselves to another winter in silence every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother resigned the post after twenty years again, and the shop remembered that half.
